item_name: Disclosure Requirements of Subpart H of Regulation H (Consumer Protections in Sales of Insurance)
mdrm_description: Subpart H of Regulation H was adopted pursuant to section 305 of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act of 1999 (GLBA); which required the federal banking agencies to issue joint regulations governing retail sales practices; solicitations; advertising; and offers of insurance by; on behalf of; or at the offices of insured depository institutions.  The insurance consumer protection rules in Regulation H require depository institutions to prepare and provide certain disclosures to consumers. Covered persons are required to make certain disclosures before the completion of the initial sale of an insurance product or annuity to a consumer and at the time a consumer applies for an extension of credit in connection with which and insurance product or annuity is solicited; offered; or sold.

item_name: Financial Statements of Foreign Subsidiaries of U.S. Banking Organizations
mdrm_description: These reports collect selected financial information for direct or indirect foreign subsidiaries of U.S. state member banks (SMBs); Edge and agreement corporations; and bank holding companies (BHCs). The FR 2314S collects four financial data items for smaller; less complex subsidiaries.  (Note:  The Report of Condition for Foreign Subsidiaries of U.S. Banking Organizations; FR 2314a and FR 2314c have been replaced by the FR 2314 and FR 2314S. and the FR 2314b has been discontinued.

item_name: HMDA Loan/Application Register (as required by Reg C; the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act)
mdrm_description: This report collects information from mortgage lenders on applications for; and originations and purchases of; mortgage and home improvement loans. State member banks (SMBs); subsidiaries of SMBs and bank holding companies; U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks (other than federal branches; federal agencies and insured state branches of foreign banks); commercial lending companies owned or controlled by foreign banks; and Edge and agreement corporations are required to use the report as a running log throughout the calendar year. Effective for the calendar year 2017 report and forward; this report is submitted to the Consumer Financial Protection Agency.

item_name: International Applications and Prior Notifications Under Subpart B of Regulation K
mdrm_description: Foreign banks are required to obtain the prior approval of the Federal Reserve to establish a branch; agency; or representative office; to acquire ownership or control of a commercial lending company in the United States; or to change the status of any existing office in the United States.  The Federal Reserve uses the information; in part; to fulfill its statutory obligation to supervise foreign banking organizations with offices in the United States.

mdrm_description: Section 342 of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act of 2010 (Dodd-Frank Act) requires the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC); Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (Board); Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC); National Credit Union Administration (NCUA); Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection (CFPB); and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) (the agencies) each to establish an Office of Minority and Women Inclusion (OMWI) to be responsible for all matters of the agency relating to diversity in management; employment; and business activities. The FCRA requires consumer reporting agencies to adopt reasonable procedures that are fair and equitable to the consumer with regard to the confidentiality; accuracy; relevancy; and proper utilization of consumer information. Congress substantially amended the FCRA upon the passage of the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act of 2003 (FACT Act). item_name: Notice Requirements in Connection with Regulation W (Transactions Between Member Banks and Their Affiliates)
mdrm_description: This information is required to evidence compliance with sections 23A and 23B of the Federal Reserve Act (12 U.S.C. 371c and 3c-1) or to request an exemption from the Board. item_name: Prohibited Service at Savings and Loan Holding Companies (Application for exemption)
mdrm_description: he Federal Deposit Insurance (FDI) Act and Regulation LL - Savings and Loan Holding Companies (12 CFR Part 238) prohibit individuals who have been convicted of certain criminal offenses or who have agreed to enter into a pretrial diversion or similar program in connection with a prosecution for such criminal offenses from participating in the affairs of a savings and loan holding company (SLHC) or any of its subsidiaries without the written consent of the Board. Such an individual; or the SLHC in which the individual seeks to participate in the affairs thereof; may apply for an exemption from this prohibition. There is no reporting form associated with this information collection; however; an exemption request to the Board may be filed in letter form.

item_name: Quarterly Report of Interest Rates on Selected Direct Consumer Installment Loans; and Quarterly Report on Credit Card Plans
mdrm_description: The FR 2835 collects interest rate information on consumer installment loans for new automobiles and on loans for other consumer goods and personal expenditures. The other -- average computed interest rates -- is derived from two items: total finance charges assessed to cardholders during the period and the total of balances on which the finance charges were determined. Also; the reporting form asks for total number of accounts and total balances for all accounts.

item_name: Recordkeeping and Disclosure Requirements Associated with Loans Secured by Real Estate Located in Flood Hazard Areas Pursuant to Section 208.25 of Regulation H
mdrm_description: The disclosure and recordkeeping requirements under this section of Regulation H are imposed on state member banks to implement requirements of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (as amended) and the Flood Disaster Protection Act of 1973 (as amended). The regulation forbids banks to make or renew loans secured by real estate located in a flood hazard unless it is insured against flooding.

item_name: Recordkeeping Associated with Leveraged Lending Guidance
mdrm_description: The Board adopted amendments to Regulation A - Extensions of Credit by Federal Reserve Banks to implement the emergency lending authorities provided under the 3rd undesignated paragraph of section 13 of the Federal Reserve Act (FRA) as amended by sections 1101 and 1103 of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act (the Dodd-Frank Act). item_name: Recordkeeping Requirements Associated with Real Estate Lending Standards

State member banks must adopt and maintain a written real estate lending policy that is reviewed and approved by the bank's board of directors at least annually. Also; these banks must identify in their loan records loans in excess of the Board's supervisory loan-to-value (LTV) limits. There is no formal reporting form and the information is not submitted to the Board.

item_name: Savings and Loan Holding Company Application

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: LOANS TO DEPOSITORY INSTITUTIONS
mdrm_description: Extensions of credit by Federal Reserve Banks are governed by Regulation A and Operating Circular 10 of each Bank. Loans to depository institutions are carried at face amount in a single account on the balance sheet. The interest is accrued on a daily basis and collected at maturity. Loans to depository institutions are pledged by each Reserve Bank as collateral for Federal Reserve notes. Loans should be evaluated for FAM - 2010 1 - 24 collectability on a quarterly basis and the results of the evaluation should be provided to the RBOPS FRB Financial Accounting Section.

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: ACCEPTANCES BOUGHT OUTRIGHT
mdrm_description: The New York Reserve Bank; in carrying out the domestic policy directive adopted by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC); may be authorized to purchase or make repurchase agreements with dealers. Some repurchase agreements may be secured by bankers' acceptances and mature after a fixed period; usually one to seven days. Acceptances arise out of the shipment of goods between countries or within the United States or from the storage of goods within the United States pending marketing. All holdings of acceptances or repurchase agreements secured by acceptances are retained on the New York Bank's balance sheet and are not allocated to other Reserve Banks. When acceptances are purchased or sold; the net amount of the transaction is paid to or collected by the New York Bank from the dealer.

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: LOAN FEES DEFERRED
mdrm_description: Nonrefundable fees; such as origination or commitment fees; paid to the Bank by borrowers; based on the terms of the agreement; are recorded in this account. As described in FASB ASC Topic 310-20; formerly SFAS No. 91; such fees are to be deferred and recognized as income over the life of the loan. The unamortized balance of deferred loan fees should be reported in the Bank's financial statements as an offset to the related loan balance. The periodic amortization of balances in this account should generally be recorded as an addition to interest income; but in some circumstances may be recorded as fees in the profit and loss accounts (330-100).  Contact Board staff to discuss the proper accounting for deferred loan fees.

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: AIG ALLOWANCE FOR LOAN MODIFICATION
mdrm_description: Pursuant to a loan restructuring plan; the New York Reserve Bank reduced the interest rate on the AIG Revolving Credit Facility effective April 17; 2009. (The rate was reduced to 3 percent plus the 3-month LIBOR rate; previously there was a 3.5 percent floor on the LIBOR rate.) The allowance; which reflects the future income foregone from the reduced interest rate; is amortized using the effective interest method over the remaining term of the loans; pursuant to the terms of the troubled debt restructuring (see paragraph 81.09).

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: ALLOWANCE FOR LOAN LOSSES
mdrm_description: In accordance with paragraph 1.06; Reserve Banks are required to recognize a loss on a loan when it is probable that the loan will be uncollectible in whole or in part and the amounts of losses are estimable. Detailed instructions on how to recognize; measure; and record an allowance for loans loss are provided in paragraph 81.01 Allowance for Loan Losses. The Reserve Banks should use account 145-360 to record allowances for loan losses. Allowances recorded in this account must be approved by the RBOPS FRB Financial Accounting Section.

item_name: LOANS AND SECURITIES: AIG LOAN AND CAPITALIZED INTEREST
mdrm_description: This account is used to record the amount outstanding under the AIG credit facility. Interest accrued on the outstanding principal balance is capitalized quarterly and added to the balance in this account. In addition; AIG is charged a commitment fee on the undrawn portion of the credit facility; and the accrued amount of the commitment fee is capitalized quarterly and added to the balance in this account.

The New York Reserve Bank will record all TALF loans at fair value under FASB ASC Topic 825-10; formerly SFAS No. 159; rather than at the remaining principal amount outstanding. Recording the TALF loans at fair value improves accounting consistency and results in appropriate GAAP presentation of the TALF program on a consolidated basis by matching the change in fair value of TALF loans with changes in the value of the related TALF LLC commitment. In addition; recording all TALF-related assets and liabilities at fair value represents the economics of the program.  Pursuant to the put agreement with the New York Reserve Bank; the TALF LLC

mdrm_description: This account represents depository institution discount window loans that have been subsequently assumed by the FDIC. Payment and maturity schedules are worked out with the FDIC on a case-by-case basis.

item_name: OTHER ASSETS: PREMIUM ON SECURITIES
mdrm_description: Premium on securities represents the unamortized amount paid in excess of the face value of securities in the System Open Market Account. On the date of purchase; such excess is debited to this account and daily thereafter an equal portion of the premiums; computed on individual issues; is credited to the account. The daily straight-line amortization is determined by dividing the premiums paid by the number of days to the call date of the issue. Amortization of premiums on Federal agency and GSE mortgage-backed securities is determined based on an effective yield calculation. When securities are sold; any applicable premium is credited to the account. All entries are made upon advice from the New York Reserve Bank.

item_name: OTHER ASSETS: OTHER REAL ESTATE; NET
mdrm_description: Property purchased for future bank use is reported in this account pending final approval of the site for construction. Upon final approval of the site; the property is transferred to the Bank premises accounts. Bank-owned property which has been vacated pending disposition should be transferred to this account and carried at net realizable value.

item_name: OTHER DEPOSITS: INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS
mdrm_description: This account consists of balances of international organizations; such as the International Monetary Fund; Bank for Reconstruction and Development; Inter-American Development Bank; Asian Development Bank; International Development Bank and International Finance Corporation. The law provides that any Reserve Bank which is requested to do so by such organizations should act as its depository or as its fiscal agent; and requires the Board of Governors to supervise and direct the carrying out of these functions.

item_name: OTHER DEPOSITS: GOVERNMENT SPONSORED ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS
mdrm_description: GSEs such as the Federal National Mortgage Association maintain redemption accounts with the New York Reserve Bank to cover maturing coupons and securities that are received by Reserve Banks for payment. Balances are maintained by the GSEs to cover the amounts that are due on any given payment date. Payments on definitive obligations by Reserve Banks other than the New York Reserve Bank are carried in the miscellaneous cash items account pending charge to the New York Reserve Bank.  Payments by the New York Reserve Bank are entered directly to the unclassified account.  When the paid coupons and securities are verified according to the respective GSE; the New York Reserve Bank credits the unclassified account and charges the appropriate GSE account.

item_name: RESERVE FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: The accumulation of all so-called 'tax free' reserves against loan losses allowed under current rulings of the Internal Revenue Service. Reserves greater than IRS allowances are reported against 'Other Reserves on Loans (3130).   COMPARABILITY:    Beginning 3/31/76; not shown separately. The valuation portion of this reserve is shown as 'Reserve for  Possible Loan Losses (3123)'; the contingency portion is included in 'Undivided Profits (3250)'; and the deferred tax portion is reported in 'Other Liabilities (2936; 2937)'.   Prior to 6/30/69; includes reserves greater than IRS allowance for RCON file.

item_name: RESERVE FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES ON LOANS - PRECEDING YEAR
mdrm_description: The amount of 'Reserve for Bad Debt Losses on Loans (3120)' for the preceding year.

item_name: OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: All reserves on loans which are in excess of allowable Internal Revenue Service reserves for bad debts.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 6/30/69; not shown separately but included in 'Reserves for Bad Debt Losses on Loans (3120)'.

item_name: OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS - PRECEDING YEAR
mdrm_description: The amount of 'Other Reserves on Loans (3130)' for the preceding year.

item_name: RESERVES ON SECURITIES
mdrm_description: All reserves on securities carried on the books of the reporting bank; including trading account securities; if any.    COMPARABILITY:     For the period 12/31/65 thru 12/31/68; for RCON file; shown in 'memoranda' section. Although an  amount may appear here for these dates; it is not included in 'Total Reserves on Loans and Securities (3100).'    Prior to 6/30/65; for the RCON file; not shown separately but included in detailed investment items.

item_name: INTEREST AND DIVIDENDS ON OTHER SECURITIES
mdrm_description: Earnings on all assets which in condition reports are reported as other securities (0600; 0900; 0950). Includes  interest and dividends on obligations of states and political subdivisions; other bonds; notes; and debentures; and corporate stocks (including stock of Federal Reserve Bank).   COMPARABILITY:   The following change in definition occurred in the Report of Condition;    Prior to 6/30/66; excludes Export-Import portfolio fund participations which are included in 'Total Loans; Gross (1400).'

item_name: INTEREST AND DISCOUNT ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Interest and discount (both current and past due interest) on all assets which in condition reports are reported as  loans and discounts. This includes interest and discount on acceptances; commercial paper purchased in open market;  drafts for which bank has given deposit credit to customers; etc.; and on paper which has been rediscounted with Federal  Reserve or other banks; sold under repurchase agreement; or pledged as collateral to secure bills payable or for any other purpose.    Profits (or losses) resulting from sale of acceptances and commercial paper at discount rates other than those at which such paper was purchased is included in (or deducted from) this item.    Interest or discount rebated to customers on loans paid before maturity is deducted from gross interest and discount

item_name: SERVICE CHARGES AND FEES ON BANK'S LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes investigation and service charges; renewal and past due charges; commitment fees; and fees charged for execution of mortgages or agreements securing the bank's loans.   Does not include reimbursements for out of pocket expenditures made by the bank for account of its customers.

item_name: OTHER SERVICE CHARGES; COMMISSIONS; FEES; AND COLLECTION AND EXCHANGE CHARGES
mdrm_description: Includes commissions on sale of insurance policies and collection of premiums (when permitted by state law);  charges for collection of domestic checks; notes; and bills of exchange; collection of bills for public utilities and other  firms; etc.; sale of bank drafts; acceptances of bills of exchange in the domestic trade; purchase and sale of securities;  acceptances; and commercial paper for domestic banks and other customers; negotiation of loans for customers or  correspondents; lending of securities owned by bank; servicing of FHA real estate mortgage loans held by others; reimbursements received for services in redeeming U.S. savings bonds; etc.   Does not include reimbursements for out of pocket expenditures made by bank for account of its customers.

item_name: OTHER CURRENT OPERATING REVENUE
mdrm_description: All current operating revenue of the bank not required to be reported against the above sub-items. Includes gross  income from foreign and other departments (except building department); gross rentals from other real estate; and safe deposit boxes; net profits from foreign branches; and interest on time balances with other banks.    Excludes all rentals from banking house and other bank premises. Rebates or refunds on tax payments or dividends on insurance premiums are netted against the appropriate expense items.

item_name: RECURRING DEPRECIATION ON BANK PREMISES AND LEASEHOLD IMPROVEMENTS
mdrm_description: Normal and recurring depreciation charges applicable to current year; whether representing direct reductions in carrying value of the assets or additions to depreciation reserves.   COMPARABILITY:   Beginning 1/31/1997; for the CUCP report; includes single period amortization of leasehold improvements.   NOTE:   Reported on Schedule IS-5 for the CUCP report.

item_name: MAINTENANCE; REPAIRS; AND UNCAPITALIZED ALTERATION COSTS OF BANK PREMISES AND LEASEHOLD IMPROVEMENTS
mdrm_description: Includes ordinary repairs to bank premises and leasehold improvements and cost of leasehold improvements not placed on bank's books as an assets.

item_name: RENT PAID ON BANK PREMISES
mdrm_description: Includes all rents paid on bank premises and parking lots as well as rents paid to bank building affiliates and  interest on liens or other encumbrances on bank premises owned; but not such expenses incurred in 'Real Estate Owned Other Than Bank Premises (2150).'

item_name: TAXES ON BANK PREMISES AND LEASEHOLD IMPROVEMENTS
mdrm_description: Includes all property and other taxes related to bank premises; and leasehold improvements paid or accrued;  including deficiency payments; net of all rebates; refunds; or credits received during period and adjusted for all over or under accruals.

item_name: OTHER CURRENT OPERATING EXPENSES
mdrm_description: All current operating expenses of bank not required to be reported against any of the above sub-items. This  includes: premiums on fidelity insurance; operating expenses (except salaries) of 'Real Estate Owned Other Than Bank  Premises (2150)' including interest paid on liens and normal or recurring depreciation charges on 'Real Estate Owned  Other Than Bank Premises (2150)'; office supplies bought; cost of examinations by supervisory authorities; retainer fees; expenses related to use of automobiles for bank business; etc. Includes taxes not reported against other items.    Deposit insurance assessment expense is reported as a net figure; i.e.; all assessment credits during period are  applied against assessment expense. item_name: RECOVERIES; TRANSFERS FROM VALUATION RESERVES; AND PROFITS
mdrm_description: The term 'valuation reserves' means all unallocated charge-offs; valuation allowances; and similar reserves  deducted from loans; securities; and other assets to provide for bad debts and other losses. Such reserves relate for the  most part to loans and securities; and the section 'Reserve for Bad Debts and Other Valuation Reserves' is provided for a  reconcilement of these reserves. Losses and recoveries; when debited and credited to reserves for losses on loans and  securities and not directly to undivided profits; are reported only in the section 'Reserve for Bad Debts and Other  Valuation Reserves.' item_name: RECOVERIES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Recoveries of amounts previously reported as charge-offs on loans and discounts; provided there is no valuation  reserve for loan losses; if such a valuation reserve exists; recoveries of losses on loans previously charged to the reserve  are credited back to the reserve and reported in the section; 'Reserves on Loans' but not against this item. (Recoveries of losses not previously charged to reserves are credited directly to undivided profits and reported here.)

item_name: TRANSFERS FROM VALUATION RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Valuation reserves previously set up on loans but returned to undivided profits during the current period.

item_name: ALL OTHER RECOVERIES; TRANSFERS FROM VALUATION RESERVES; AND PROFITS
mdrm_description: Profits on real estate sold; net cash overages; valuation reserves previously set up on 'other real estate' and  returned to undivided profits during current period; and any other miscellaneous recoveries. Credits or over accruals of  federal deposit insurance assessments and other expenses are not treated as recoveries; these are applied against the appropriate expense item and reported as a net figure.

item_name: CHARGE-OFFS ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Losses and charge-offs on loans (except losses charged against valuation reserves). If a valuation reserve for loan  losses exists; losses are reported in 'Reserves on Loans' section and not here. Includes premiums on real estate  mortgages or other loans charged off in a lump sum. Does not include current amortization of premiums on loans; which is deducted from 'Interest And Discount On Loans (5006)'.

item_name: TRANSFERS TO VALUATION RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Charges whereby valuation reserves (including reserves for bad debt losses on loans set up pursuant to IRS rulings) are created or increased to provide for estimated losses on loans.

item_name: ALL OTHER LOSSES AND CHARGE-OFFS
mdrm_description: All other losses and charge-offs (except losses charged against valuation reserves). Includes extraordinary or  nonrecurring write-downs on banking house; 'other real estate'; and furniture and fixtures; and additions to depreciation  reserves for the same purposes; losses on counterfeit money and forged checks; net cash shortages charged off;  miscellaneous losses resulting from lawsuits; bank's own contribution to its retirement or pension fund covering service  for past periods; etc. Payments or accruals of reserves for federal deposit insurance assessments and other expenses are not treated as charge-offs; but are reported as current operating expenses.

item_name: ADDITIONS TO RESERVE SET UP FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES; DUE TO MERGERS AND ABSORPTIONS
mdrm_description: All valuation reserves on loans carried over from the books of banks merged; consolidated; purchases or  absorbed by the reporting bank during report period. Includes only such reserves carried on books of absorbed bank at the time accounts were consolidated with accounts of continuing bank.

item_name: RECOVERIES CREDITED TO RESERVES FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES
mdrm_description: Recoveries of amounts previously charged against valuation reserves for bad debt losses on loans; these recoveries are credited directly to valuation reserves and not to undivided profits.

item_name: LOSSES CHARGED TO RESERVE FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES
mdrm_description: Actual losses on loans during period. These losses are debited directly to valuation reserves and not to undivided profits.

item_name: TRANSFERS FROM RESERVE FOR BAD DEBT LOSSES

item_name: ADDITIONS TO OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS; DUE TO MERGERS AND ABSORPTIONS
mdrm_description: All other reserves on loans carried over from the books of banks merged; consolidated; purchased or absorbed by  reporting bank during report period. Includes only such reserves carried on books of absorbed bank at the time accounts were consolidated with accounts of continuing bank.

item_name: RECOVERIES CREDITED TO OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Recoveries of amounts previously charged against other reserves on loans; these recoveries are credited directly to valuation reserves and not to undivided profits.

item_name: TRANSFERS TO OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Amounts transferred to other reserves on loans during period for purpose of increasing the reserve to provide for additional possible losses.

item_name: TOTAL OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Sum of 'Other Reserves On Loans - Balance Preceding Year (5160)'; 'Additions To Other Reserves On Loans;  Due To Mergers And Absorptions (5162)'; 'Recoveries Credited To Other Reserves On Loans (5164)' and 'Transfers To Other Reserves On Loans (5166)'.

item_name: LOSSES CHARGED TO OTHER RESERVES ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Actual losses on loans during period. These losses are debited directly to valuation reserves and not to undivided profits.

item_name: TRANSFERS FROM RESERVES ON SECURITIES
mdrm_description: Amounts transferred from reserves on securities during period by reason of the following:    (1)   Because the valuation reserve is no longer required or is deemed to be excessive; and all or a portion of       such reserve is returned to undivided profits. item_name: UNDRAWN COMMITMENTS AND CONTINGENT LIQUIDITY NEEDS:  COMMITTED LIQUIDITY FACILITIES TO NON-FINANCIAL CORP
mdrm_description: Report undrawn liquidity commitments provided to external non-financial corporate entities and Public Sector Entities (PSEs). A liquidity facility is defined as any committed; undrawn back-up facility put in place expressly for the purpose of refinancing the debt of a customer in situations where such a customer is unable to obtain its ordinary course of business funding requirements (e.g. pursuant to a commercial paper program) in the financial markets. Non-Financial Corp definition: Non-financial corporations are corporations that do not qualify as a Financial Institution.  Note:  Item N754 exists on the FR2052a report form; line 15.12.  However; the line item title is worded differently.  It reads; 'Contingency Line Items:  Facilities Provided to Non-Financial Corporates.'

LOAN COMMITMENTS FOR MORTGAGES: TOTAL
mdrm_description: The total of loan commitments for mortgages unused (1413) and used (1412). Commitments are official promises to lend that are expressly conveyed; orally or in writing; to the customer.    Excludes authorizations (internal guidance lines) where the customer is not informed of the amount. Also; excludes cases such as those when loan funds are temporarily unavailable pending loan committee approval.    Mortgage loans are those specified in 'Real Estate Loans (1410)'. Includes all loans secured primarily by  mortgages; deeds of trust; land contracts; or other liens on real estate. Excludes loans to finance construction in process if not secured by a mortgage or other lien on real estate.

item_name: LOAN COMMITMENTS FOR MORTGAGES: USED
mdrm_description: Refer to 'Loan Commitments for Mortgages: Total (1411)' for definition of commitments and mortgage loans. Used commitments are all loans; less repayments of principal; made under commitments currently or previously in force.

item_name: LOAN COMMITMENTS FOR MORTGAGES: UNUSED
mdrm_description: Refer to 'Loan Commitments for Mortgages: Total (1411)' for definition of commitments and mortgage loans.  Unused commitments are the amounts still available under commitment arrangements; but not borrowed; as of the indicated date. Excludes any takedowns; expirations; and cancellations.

item_name: LOAN COMMITMENTS FOR MORTGAGES: NEW
mdrm_description: Refer to 'Loan Commitments for Mortgages: Total (1411)' for definition of commitments and mortgage loans.  New commitments are the amounts of additional commitments; except renewals; that have been arranged since the last monthly report. Includes the total amount even if some or all of the commitments have been used.

item_name: COMMITMENTS FOR LOANS TO NONBANK FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS - TOTAL
mdrm_description: The total of commitments for loans to nonbank financial institutions unused (1523) and outstanding loans  (1522). Refer to 'Loan Commitments for Mortgages - Total (1411)' for definition of commitments. Loans to nonbank  financial institutions are those specified for 'Loans to Other Depository Institutions (1538)' and 'Loans to Other  Financial Institutions (1539)'. Excludes loans for purchasing and carrying securities and mortgages. Includes loans for mortgage warehousing; but not mortgage loans themselves.

item_name: COMMITMENTS FOR LOANS TO NONBANK FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS - OUTSTANDING LOANS

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING THAT WAS SOLD IN NON-US MARKETS; EITHER DIRECTLY OR THROUGH DEALERS
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of outstanding commercial paper that was sold in non-U.S. markets; such as the Euro  commercial paper market or any other non-U.S. paper market.  Reporters that have facilities to sell paper in non-U.S.  markets but have no paper outstanding should report 'o'. Reporters that do not have facilities to sell paper in non-U.S. markets should report 'n.a.'

item_name: COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING ISSUED BY SPECIAL PURPOSE CORPORATIONS THAT INVEST THE PROCEEDS IN ASSETS THAT; IN TURN; SERVE AS COLLATERAL FOR THE ISSUED PAPER
mdrm_description: Includes paper reported in item 6696 that is issued by special purpose corporations that purchase assets or make  direct loans. Includes only the commercial paper issued by special purpose corporations established as going  concerns--i.e.; to purchase assets or make loans and issue paper on an ongoing basis--rather than as vehicles with  planned finite lives. In particular; paper used for bridge financing of assets and collateralized by those assets is excluded.

item_name: COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING AS RATED BY NATIONALLY RECOGNIZED STATISTICAL RATING ORGANIZATIONS AS DEFINED BY THE SEC - FIRST TIER SECURITY
mdrm_description: Includes paper that would be classified as a First Tier security under paragraph (a)(6) of Rule 2a-7 under the  Investment Company Act of 1940. A First Tier security is an eligible security with a '1' rating; the highest; from two or more of the rating agencies.    These rating agencies are:    Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co.;    Fitch Investors Service; Inc.;    IBCA Limited;    Moody's Investors Service;    Standard & Poor's Corporation; and    Thomson BankWatch

item_name: COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING AS RATED BY NATIONALLY RECOGNIZED STATISTICAL RATING ORGANIZATIONS AS DEFINED BY THE SEC - SECOND TIER SECURITY
mdrm_description: Includes paper that would be classified as a Second Tier security under paragraph (a)(14) of Rule 2a-7 under the Investment Company Act of 1940. A Second Tier security is an eligible security that is not in the first tier.

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES
mdrm_description: Financial companies are institutions engaged primarily in activities such as; but not limited to; commercial;  savings; and mortgage banking; sales; personal; and mortgage financing; factoring; finance leasing; and other business  lending; insurance underwriting; and other investment activities. Also; includes as financial; the commercial paper  issued by special purpose funding companies. Specifically; these are corporations that are organized for the sole purpose  of issuing commercial paper in their own names and transmitting the proceeds to a third party. Commercial paper placed for banks or other financial institutions domiciled in foreign countries should also be included in item 6702.     Includes outstanding paper placed for companies classified under SEC Industry Code 6022 - 6500

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - DOMESTIC COMPANIES
mdrm_description: Includes paper of financial companies domiciled in the United States. Also includes paper of affiliates foreign parents if affiliates are domiciled in the United States. This item includes the sum of items 6698 and 6701.    Excludes paper of foreign parents. (Parent means the direct principal owner of the issuer of the paper.)

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - DOMESTIC COMPANIES WITH FOREIGN PARENT
mdrm_description: Includes paper of United States domiciled financial entities whose parents are domiciled outside of the United States. This item includes the sum of items 6699 and 6700.

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - DOMESTIC COMPANIES WITH FOREIGN BANK OR BHC PARENT
mdrm_description: Includes paper of a United States financial affiliate whose foreign parent is a bank or bank holding company.

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - DOMESTIC COMPANIES WITH FOREIGN NONBANK PARENT
mdrm_description: Includes paper of a United States financial affiliate whose foreign parent is a financial institution other than a bank or bank holding company; or is a nonfinancial institution.

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - DOMESTIC COMPANIES - ALL OTHER
mdrm_description: Includes paper of all financial entities domiciled in the United States without a foreign parent.

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - FOREIGN COMPANIES

item_name: TOTAL COMMERCIAL PAPER OUTSTANDING PLACED FOR FINANCIAL COMPANIES - FOREIGN COMPANIES - OTHER

item_name: ALL OUTSTANDING COMMERCIAL PAPER REPORTED IN ITEMS 6431 AND 6432
mdrm_description: Include in the calculation all notes outstanding; regardless of when they were issued. The maturity in these calculations should correspond to the remaining maturity of the note (i.e.; the number of days until the note matures).

item_name: ALL OUTSTANDING COMMERCIAL PAPER REPORTED IN ITEM 6727
mdrm_description: Included in the calculation are all notes outstanding; regardless of when they were issued. The maturity in the calculations should correspond to the remaining maturity of the notes (i.e.; the number of days until the note matures).

item_name: EFFECTIVE INTEREST RATE (QTFL)
mdrm_description: The effective rate of interest is the ratio of the realized yield from compound interest for one year to the amount of the loan. (Carried as a single precision floating point field.)

item_name: BLOW-UP FACTOR OF BANK TO STRATUM (AS PART OF SUBSAMPLE)
mdrm_description: The blow-up factor of bank to stratum; as part of subsample; is determined by using Call data for both numerator and denominator.       The numerator is composed of total commercial & industrial loan values for all banks that fall in the stratum associated with the loan in question; such as all banks in stratum three if the loan was from a stratum three bank.       The denominator is composed of total commercial & industrial loan values for the responding subsample banks in the same stratum as the numerator. (Approximately 10 banks.)

item_name: BLOW-UP FACTOR OF LOAN TO BANK (QTFL)
mdrm_description: Stratum one banks report loan figures for two or three days as assigned. The remaining banks report for five days. The blow-up factor to equalize data has a value of 5/2; 5/3; or 1 respectively.

item_name: BLOW-UP FACTOR OF BANK TO STRATUM (AS PART OF SAMPLE) (QTFL)
mdrm_description: The blow-up factor of bank to stratum; as part of sample; is determined by using Call data for both numerator and denominator.    The numerator is composed of total commercial and industrial loan values for all banks that fall in the stratum associated with the loan in question; such as all banks in stratum three if the loan was from a stratum three bank.    The denominator is composed of total commercial and industrial loan values for the responding sample banks in the same stratum as the numerator. (Approximately 60 banks.)

A seller electing to sell to (or swap with)  FHLMC with recourse bears all risks and costs of a borrower default; including the costs of foreclosure. If the servicing of mortgages sold to (or swapped with) FHLMC with recourse is transferred; the transferee bears these risks and costs.

Deposits of commercial banks and other depository institutions in the U.S. are defined in the instructions for Schedule RC-E; item 4. item_name: AMOUNT OF THE INSTITUTION'S LARGEST COUNTERPARTY EXPOSURE
mdrm_description: Report the amount of total exposure to the counterparty to which the institution has the largest total counterparty exposure.  Counterparty exposure is equal to the sum of (1) the exposure at default (EAD) associated with derivatives trading and securities financing transactions (SFTs) and (2) the gross lending exposure (including all unfunded commitments) for each counterparty or borrower at the consolidated entity level of the counterparty.  Exclude all counterparty exposure to the U.S. Government and departments or agencies of the U.S. Government that are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States.

item_name: PURCHASED CREDIT-IMPAIRED LOANS ACCOUNTED FOR IN ACCORDANCE WITH FASB ASC 310-30 (FORMER AICPA STATEMENT OF POSITION 03-3):  OUTSTANDING BALANCE PAST DUE 30 THROUGH 89 DAYS AND STILL ACCRUING
mdrm_description: Report the outstanding balance of all purchased credit-impaired loans reported as held for investment in Schedule RC-C; part I; Memorandum item 7.a; that are past due 30 through 89 days and are still accruing as of the report date. However; the outstanding balance does not include amounts that would be accrued under the contract as interest; fees; penalties; and other after the report date.

item_name: REAL ESTATE LOANS - RENEGOTIATED 'TROUBLED' DEBT

mdrm_description: Includes the outstanding principal balance of 1-to-4 family residential mortgage loans serviced for others under  servicing contracts entered into with the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA). GNMA contracts  generally covers residential mortgage loans guaranteed by the Department of Veterans Affairs/Veterans Administration (VA) and insured by the Federal Housing Administration (FHA).

item_name: OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL BALANCE OF 1-4 FAMILY RESIDENTIAL MORTGAGE LOANS SERVICED FOR OTHERS (INCLUDING RETAINED SERVICING AND PURCHASED SERVICING): MORTGAGES SERVICED UNDER A FHLMC CONTRACT: SERVICED WITH RECOURSE TO SERVICER
mdrm_description: Includes the outstanding principal balance of 1-to-4 family residential mortgage loans serviced for others under  servicing contracts entered into with FHLMC in which the mortgages being serviced has been sold to (or swapped with)  FHLMC with recourse and the mortgage notes has been endorsed accordingly. A seller electing to sell to (or swap with)  FHLMC with recourse bears all risks and costs of a borrower default; including the costs of foreclosure. If the servicing of mortgages sold to (or swapped with) FHLMC with recourse is transferred; the transferee bears these risks and costs.

mdrm_description: The sum of 'Commercial And Industrial Loans With Predetermined Interest Rates (6119)' and 'Commercial  And Industrial Loans With Floating Interest Rates (6120)' which have a remaining maturity of one year or less. Demand  loans; loans with no stated repayment schedule and no stated maturity date; past due loans and overdrafts are considered  as having a maturity of one year or less. item_name: COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL LOANS WITH REMAINING MATURITY OF ONE YEAR OR LESS WITH PREDETERMINED INTEREST RATES
mdrm_description: Predetermined interest rates are those specified to be charged over the life of the loan; determined at the beginning of the loan; and known to both borrower and lender at that time.   NOTE:   For the FFIEC 002 report; excludes all transactions with related depository institutions.

item_name: COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL LOANS WITH REMAINING MATURITY OF ONE YEAR OR LESS WITH FLOATING INTEREST RATES
mdrm_description: Floating interest rates are those tied to some other rate (such as prime or market rate) and neither the borrower nor  lender knows at the time the loan originates the exact rate to be charged over the life of the loan. All demand loans are considered as having a floating interest rate.   NOTE:   For the FFIEC 002 report; excludes all transactions with related depository institutions.

item_name: COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL LOANS WITH REMAINING MATURITY OF MORE THAN ONE YEAR (EXCLUDING THOSE IN NONACCRUAL STATUS)

item_name: COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL LOANS WITH REMAINING MATURITY OF MORE THAN ONE YEAR WITH FLOATING INTEREST RATES

mdrm_description: Includes an estimate of the amount of principal reduction expected for the 12 month period beginning with the Call Report date.

item_name: AMOUNT OF FIRM REAL ESTATE LOAN COMMITMENTS OUTSTANDING
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of binding real loan commitments; written or oral; outstanding on the Call Report date.   NOTE:   This item is reported by mutual savings banks only.

item_name: AMOUNT OF PAST DUE REAL ESTATE LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of past due real estate loans included in 'Real Estate Loans (1410)'. Includes any loans on a  nonaccrual status that are also past due. Real estate installment loans are considered past due when at least two monthly  payments are delinquent. All other real estate loans are considered past due when they have passed maturity or when  interest or principle is past due and unpaid. The entire unpaid balance is reported as past due; not just the amount of the payment.

item_name: AMOUNT OF NONACCRUAL REAL ESTATE LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the unpaid balance of all real estate upon which a default of principal or interest has existed for a period  of 90 days or more. Also includes any other real estate loan that has been placed into nonaccrual status even though it does not meet the minimum criteria stated above.   NOTE:   This item is reported by mutual savings banks only.

mdrm_description: Includes allowances; reserves; etc.; which may properly be applied to reduce the amount shown in 'Other Scheduled Items - Real Estate in Judgment - Gross Amount (0794)'.

mdrm_description: Includes the outstanding principal balances of  whole loans and participating interest in loans reported in items  0131; 0109; 0133; 2687; 2689; 0113; 0136; and 1534 owned by the institution but serviced by others at the close of the quarter. item_name: TOTAL NUMBER OF CONVENTIONAL LOANS AND CONTRACTS - BALANCE AT CLOSE OF  PERIOD NUMBER

item_name: WHOLE LOANS SOLD TO FHLMC - ACTIVITY DURING PERIOD - NUMBER

mdrm_description: The amount at the time of sale of all whole loans sold to FHLMC during the report period.

item_name: APPROXIMATE VALUE OF TRUST ASSETS ADMINISTERED

Both discretionary and nondiscretionary trust and custodial accounts;   2.  Assets subject to shared investment discretion;   3.  Assets for which the savings association has fiduciary responsibility that are being serviced by an investment advisor.   Do not include:   1.  IRA and Keogh accounts which are reported in item 0986;   2.  Trusts forming part of a stock bonus; pension; or profit-sharing plan for the benefit of the reporting savings association's employees; and    3.  Custodial activities under loan servicing agreements.   NOTE:   Definition revised 9/30/1998.

item_name: FHA-HUD SINGLE FAMILY LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes all loans secured primarily by single family dwelling units that are guaranteed by the Federal Housing  Administration and Housing and Urban Development whether made directly; are purchased; or represent a participating  interest. item_name: FHA-HUD 2-4 DWELLING UNIT LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes '2 to 4' multiple dwelling unit structures; other than condominiums; such as ordinary and cooperative  apartments. Also includes fraternity and sorority house offering sleeping accommodations and living accommodations at a college or hospital.

item_name: OTHER IMPROVED REAL ESTATE INSURED BY FHA-HUD
mdrm_description: Includes real estate on which is located structures; whether existing or under construction; not covered in the  definitions of single and multiple dwelling units. item_name: LAND LOANS INSURED BY FHA-HUD
mdrm_description: Includes: (1) real estate upon which all facilities and improvements have been completely installed; as required  by local regulations and practices; that are entirely prepared for erection of structures; (2) loans to finance the  purchase of land and accomplishment of all improvement required to convert it to developed building lots; and (3) loans secured by real estate upon which there is no structure.

item_name: OTHER LOANS INSURED BY FHA-HUD

item_name: LOANS ON SINGLE FAMILY; CONVENTIONAL
mdrm_description: Includes single family conventional loans. item_name: LOANS ON 2-4 DWELLING UNITS; CONVENTIONAL
mdrm_description: Includes conventional 2-4 dwelling units loans. item_name: LOANS ON OTHER IMPROVED REAL ESTATE; CONVENTIONAL
mdrm_description: Includes conventional loans on other improved real estate. item_name: LOANS ON DEVELOPED BUILDING LOTS; CONVENTIONAL

item_name: LOANS ON ACQUISITION AND DEVELOPMENT OF LAND

item_name: LOANS ON UNIMPROVED LAND; CONVENTIONAL
mdrm_description: Total amount of loans secured by real estate upon which there is no structure.

item_name: NONCONFORMING LOANS TO FACILITATE SALE OF REO

item_name: NONCONFORMING CONTRACTS TO FACILITATE SALE OF REO

Does not include VA guaranteed loans; FHA-HUD insured loans or contracts having the benefit of FSLIC guaranty.

item_name: PARTICIPATIONS OR MORTGAGE-BACKED SECURITIES INSURED OR GUARANTEED BY AN INSTRUMENT OR AGENCY OF THE UNITED STATES

mdrm_description: Includes accrued interest received on all mortgage loans and contracts that are not insured or guaranteed by the  VA or FHA-HUD but which is maintained in separate accounts. COMPARABILITY:  Beginning 3/31/84; this item on the SVGL report is a derived item that includes 'Profit on Sale of Foreclosed Real Estate (REO) (4293)' and 'Profit on Sale of Other Repossessed Property (4294)'.

item_name: PROFITS ON SALE OF LOANS
mdrm_description: Total amount of profit including premiums earned as a result of the sale of any mortgage loan or contract or of the sale of participating interest in such loans or contracts.

item_name: PROFITS ON SALE OF OTHER ASSETS
mdrm_description: Total amount of profit earned on assets that cannot properly be included in any other category of assets sold. Includes all profit earned during the period as a result of the sale of real estate held as an investment or for development.

item_name: OTHER OPERATING EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Legal Expense (4141)'; 'Directors; Officers and Employee Expense (4142)'; 'Furniture;  Fixtures; Equipment; Automobile Expense (4221)'; 'Commissions Paid for Savings Accounts (4144)'; 'Insurance and  Surety Bond Premiums (4145)'; 'Federal Insurance Premium (4146)'; 'Independent Audit Expense (4147)'; 'Tax and  Accounting Services (4148)'; 'Supervisory Examinations (4149)'; 'Consultant and Management Fee (4151)'; 'Loan  Expenses (4152)'; 'Contributions (4153)'; 'Service Fees on Loans Purchased (4154)' and 'Other Operating Expenses (4240)'.

item_name: NONOPERATING EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Expense on Real Estate Held for Development and Investment (4155)'; 'Real Estate  Owned Expense (4156)'; 'Interest Expense on FHLBank Advances (4173)'; 'Interest on Subordinated Notes and  Debentures (4200)'; 'Interest Expense on Mortgage Bonds (4175)'; 'Interest Expense on Borrowed Money (4177)' and 'Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Real Estate Owned (4179)'.  NOTE:   Data was not placed on the Archival files.

item_name: LOAN EXPENSES
mdrm_description: Total amount of expense incurred in making; acquiring or servicing a loan absorbed by the association.

item_name: SERVICE FEES ON LOANS PURCHASED
mdrm_description: Includes fees paid to others to service mortgage and nonmortgage loans.     Also includes:   1.  Fees for servicing loans owned by the reporting association and its consolidated subsidiaries.   2.  Fees for servicing loans owned by others where the reporting association owns the servicing rights.   1.  Excludes amortization of purchased loan servicing rights; deduct from item 0487;					                                      2.  Servicing fees for loans acquired on a net basis; deduct from related interest income; or nonmortgage loan servicing fees; reported in item 0499.

item_name: EXPENSES ON REAL ESTATE HELD FOR DEVELOPMENT AND INVESTMENT
mdrm_description: Total amount of expenses associated with 'Real Estate Held for Development of Investment (1493)'; losses sustained in connection with the sole of this type of property is included in 'Losses on Sale of Other Assets (4158)'.

item_name: REAL ESTATE OWNED EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Total amount of expenses incurred on real estate owned or in judgment acquired through disclosure. Includes:  salaries of full-time employees required to manage the property; costs of repairs and maintenance; amount of accrued  taxes and assessments; insurance premiums; rental commissions; management fees and other expense associated with such property. Also includes the amount of depreciation of such property operated as rental property.

item_name: PROVISIONS FOR LOSSES AND LOSSES ON SALE OF LOANS
mdrm_description: Total amount of losses incurred as a result of the sale of mortgage loans and contracts or of participating interests  in such assets. Includes: (1) establishment or an increase in the related valuation allowances and reserves; (2) losses on  the origination if below market rate mortgages; and (3) losses from discounting the prepayment of low interest rate mortgages. Includes; also; all bad debts not charged to the general reserve account.

item_name: PROVISIONS FOR LOSSES AND LOSSES ON SALE OF OTHER ASSETS
mdrm_description: Total amount of losses and provisions for losses relating to assets not reported elsewhere. Includes losses on fixed  assets; e.g.; office equipment; furniture and equipment and losses on the sale of real estate held for development or investment.

item_name: OTHER NONOPERATING EXPENSES
mdrm_description: Total amount of expenses of an unusual and nonrecurring nature. Includes: (1) premiums paid in connection with  the purchase of mortgage loans and contracts if the entire amount was charged-off at the time it was incurred; (2) fully  written off or amortized good will; (3) expenses representing prior period adjustments; (4) amount of net debt made in order to convert the accrual bases of accounting.  NOTE:  Data is reported on FDR; but item not on report form.

item_name: MORTGAGE COLLATERALIZED SECURITIES ISSUED
mdrm_description: Includes interest expense and amortization of yield adjustments on all mortgage collateralized securities issued by the reporting thrift or its finance subsidiaries; reported in items 2113 and 1965.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 3/31/90; item name was 'Interest Expense on Mortgage-Backed Bonds'.

item_name: INTEREST EXPENSE ON OTHER BORROWED MONEY
mdrm_description: Total amount of interest paid on borrowed money that cannot properly be included in any category of borrowed  money. Includes interest paid on mortgages on institution premises and the gross amount of interest paid on reverse repurchase agreements.

item_name: NON-REAL ESTATE ASSETS ACQUIRED FOR STOCK
mdrm_description: Includes the carrying value in accordance with GAAP of assets other than real estate and cash; reported in  Schedule SC (Statement of Condition) acquired by the reporting institution in exchange for its common or perpetual preferred stock.   COMPARABILITY:    Prior to 3/31/90; includes the sum of items 2150; 1483; and 1484 and the item name was 'Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sales of Real Estate Owned'.    Beginning 3/31/84; this item on the SVGL report is a derived item that includes 'Nonoperating Expenses;  Provision for Losses on Sale of Foreclosed Real Estate (REO) (4327)' and 'Nonoperating Expenses Provision for Losses on Sale of Other Repossessed Property (4328)'.

item_name: NET INCOME FROM REAL ESTATE OPERATIONS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Net Income from Office Building Operations (4043)'; 'Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate  Held for Investment (4286)'; 'Net Income (Loss) from REO Operations (4287)'; 'Net Income from Service Corporations and Subsidiaries (4045)' and 'Net Income (Loss) from Leasing Operations (4291)'.

item_name: INTEREST ON BORROWINGS
mdrm_description: SVGL - Includes the sum of 'Interest Expense for Advanced Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance (4167)';  'Interest Expense on FHLBank Advances (4173)'; 'Interest on Subordinated Notes and Debentures (4200)'; 'Interest Expense on Mortgage-Backed Bonds (4175)' and 'Interest Expense on Other Borrowed Money (4177)'.  COMPARABILITY:  Beginning 1/31/1997; for the CUCP report includes all accrued interest payable on all borrowings (e.g.; promissory notes; reverse repurchase agreements; etc.).  Beginning 3/31/1990; 'Other Borrowed Money' (0482) replaced 'Interest Expense on Other Borrowed Money' (4177).  NOTE:  Reported on Schedules SFC and L-1 for the CUCP report.  The figure on Schedule SFC must equal the amount listed on Schedule L-1 line 5.

item_name: NONOPERATING EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Expense on Real Estate Held for Development and Investment (4155)'; 'Real Estate  Owned Expense (4156)'; 'Provision for Losses and Losses on Sale of Real Estate Owned (4179)'; 'Provision for Losses  and Losses on Sale of Investment Securities (4181)'; 'Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Loans (4157)'; 'Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Other Assets (4158)' and 'Other Nonoperating Expenses (4159)'.

item_name: INTEREST/DIVIDENDS ON INVESTMENTS AND DEPOSITS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Interest and Dividends on Investment and Deposits (4037)' and 'Interest on Mortgages; Participations or Mortgage-Backed Securities Insured or Guaranteed by an Agency or Instrument of the U.S. (4032)'.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS
mdrm_description: Report income on mortgage loans; including amortization of yield adjustments; reported in items 0131; 0109; 0133; 2689; 5367; 5368; 0113; 0136; and 1534. If the reporting thrift institution has bought or sold a participating interest in mortgage loans; report  only the interest applicable to the portion of the loans owned. If mortgage loans or participating interests in mortgage loans have been purchased on a net-yield basis; report the net interest earned.  If the reporting thrift assumes a liability to a third party in connection with a wrap-around mortgage loan where  the assumed liability is reported in item 0471; report the gross interest income and charge the interest incurred on the assumed liability to expense in item 0482.  Excludes amortization of yield adjustments on mortgage lo

item_name: INTEREST ON MORTGAGE-BACKED PASS-THROUGH SECURITIES
mdrm_description: Includes all interest earned during the period on assets of the type reportable in items (1454) and (1544)  (mortgage-backed pass-through securities). Includes amortization of discounts and premiums earned during the period in this item.

item_name: GROSS OCCUPANCY EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Includes: compensation of those officers and employees of the bank and its consolidated subsidiaries who spend  the major portion of their working time on bank building and related 'housekeeping' functions regardless of whether  bank has a 'building department'; all supplementary benefits paid or accrued on behalf of building department  personnel; normal and recurring depreciation charges applicable to current year; whether representing direct reductions  in carrying value of assets or additions to depreciation reserves; ordinary repairs to bank premises and leasehold  improvements and cost of leasehold improvements not placed on bank's books as an asset; all current expenses connected  with use of bank premises such as cost of heat; light; water; outside janitor services; janitor supplie

item_name: FURNITURE; FIXTURES; EQUIPMENT AND AUTOMOBILE EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Total amount of expenses related to furniture; fixtures; equipment and automobiles. Includes any depreciation  charges and the cost of any equipment that was purchased but not capitalized. Includes rental costs of office machines and  equipment; and the costs of any maintenance contracts and service bureau fees. Includes any net loss as a result of machine and equipment leased to others.

item_name: OTHER OPERATING EXPENSES
mdrm_description: Includes all operating expenses of bank not required to be reported against any of the above sub-items. This  includes fees paid to directors and members of committees for attendance at board or committee meetings (including  travel and expense allowances); cost of office 'temporaries' and contracted guards; premiums on fidelity insurance; net  foreign exchange losses; operating expenses (except salaries) connected with holdings of real estate other than bank  premises; including: interest paid on liens write-downs prescribed by the regulatory agencies; and normal or recurring  depreciation charges on 'other real estate owned'; office supplies purchased; cost of examinations by supervisory  authorities; retainer fees; expenses related to the use of automobiles and airplanes for bank busine

item_name: INTEREST ON COMMERCIAL LOANS (NONMORTGAGE)
mdrm_description: Includes interest earned during the period on assets of the type reported in items (1568) and (1569). Also includes amortization of premiums and discounts on these loans.

item_name: INTEREST ON CONSUMER LOANS (OPEN- AND CLOSED-END)
mdrm_description: Includes interest earned during the period on assets of the type reported in items (1458); (2050); (1459); (1990); (1466); (2008); and (2035). Also includes amortization of premiums and discounts on these loan.  Beginning 19880630 replace SVGL2008 with SVGL2707

item_name: INCOME FROM FINANCING LEASES
mdrm_description: Includes income earned on leveraged leases included in 'Consumer (1517)' and 'Nonconsumer (1573)'.

item_name: NET INCOME (LOSS) FROM REAL ESTATE HELD FOR INVESTMENT
mdrm_description: Includes net income (loss) during the period from the operation of real estate held as an investment or for  development as reported in items 0462; 0465; and 1581. Does not include any profits earned or losses incurred as a result  of the sale of such real estate. Such items should be reported in items 3844 or 4329. Also excludes adjustments to  valuation allowances established for real estate held for investment; report in item 0498; or credit losses; report as an increase in valuation allowances or direct charge-off in Schedule VA.   The reporting thrift's operating expenses is not allocated to this line.

item_name: NET INCOME (LOSS) FROM REO OPERATIONS
mdrm_description: Includes net income (loss) during the period from operation of repossessed assets of the type reported in items  0457; 0458; and 0459. Includes direct expenses on REO; even if the property is non-income-producing. Does not  include any profits earned or losses incurred as a result of the sale of such real estate. Such items are reported in items  3842 or 4387; adjustments to valuation allowances established on REO; are reported in item 0498; or write-downs taken when marking foreclosed assets to fair value; are reported in item 3873.   The reporting thrift's operating expenses is not allocated to this line.

item_name: STATE; LOCAL AND OTHER INCOME TAXES
mdrm_description: Excludes interest income and expense on tax accounts; reported in item 0493 or 4141; and any local taxes other than income taxes; includes real estate taxes in item 6771; includes other local taxes in item 0499.    Total amount of state; local or other taxes based on income. Also includes (1) deficiency (penalty) payments; (2)  adjustments to correct prior period accruals for which the amendment cycle is no longer open; (3) amortization of prepaid  or deferred state; local and other income taxes; (4) reductions for refunds from prior periods not previously reported; and (5) reduction for NOL carrybacks. A net credit is reported as negative.

item_name: NET INCOME (LOSS) FROM LEASING OPERATIONS
mdrm_description: Includes net income (loss) from leased property reported in item 0470.   Excludes income from financing leases; reported in items 0479 and 0480.

item_name: OTHER OPERATING INCOME
mdrm_description: Includes all ordinary or recurring operating income earned during the period that is not reported in other items in  the operating income category. Includes miscellaneous fees and charges such as those earned from the sale of money  orders or traveler's checks; redemption of savings bonds; servicing of utility bills; rental of safe deposit facilities; and  administration of trust accounts. Includes dividends earned on FHLBank and FNMA stock held and dividends on  secondary reserves (prepaid premiums to the FSLIC). Includes interest income from income tax refunds. Includes any  net income from data processing equipment or services offered to others. Any loss from data processing equipment or  services offered to others is not reported in this item; but in 'Furniture; Fixtures; Equipment and

item_name: PROFIT ON SALE OF FORECLOSED REAL ESTATE (REO)
mdrm_description: Includes profit from sale of real estate owned by the institution that in accordance with Regulation 563.231(f);  may be classified as earned during the period. Does not include any profit from the sale of real estate held as an investment  or for development which is reported in 'Profit on Sale of: Other Real Estate Held (4296)'. This item does not include losses; report losses in 'Losses on Sale of REO (4122)'.

item_name: PROFIT ON SALE OF OTHER REAL ESTATE HELD
mdrm_description: Includes profit from sale of real estate held for development/investment/resale that is reported in item (1579). This item does not include losses; report any losses in 'Losses on Sale of Other Real Estate Held (4329)'.

item_name: PROFIT ON SALE OF LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes profit (including premiums and discounts) earned during the period as a result of the sale of asset of the  type reported in the mortgage loans and contracts and nonmortgage loans categories of 'assets' or of the sale of  participating interests in such assets. This item does not include losses; which are reported in 'Losses on Sale of Loans  (4348)'. Includes reductions in provisions for losses; loan valuation allowances and specific reserves (not resulting from  a sale) that are offset by decreases in loan valuation allowances and specific reserves; reported in 'Specific Reserves and Valuation Allowances (1566) and (1574)'.

item_name: AMORTIZED DEFERRED GAINS ON LOANS SOLD
mdrm_description: Includes profit considered earned during the period in accordance with Regulation 563c.14 from the sale of loans.

item_name: PROFIT (INCLUDED ABOVE) ON SALE OF LOANS AND OTHER ASSETS ACQUIRED VIA PUSHDOWN/PURCHASE ACCOUNTING
mdrm_description: Includes profit reported in items (4293); (4294); (4296); (4122); (4297); (4298); (4299) and (4303) as a result of  the sale of loans and other assets acquired via pushdown/purchase accounting. Pushdown accounting is explained in FHLBB Memorandum R-55.

item_name: OPERATING EXPENSES EXCEPT SALARIES AND COMPENSATION; ADVERTISING AND OCCUPANCY
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Legal Expense (4141)'; 'Directors; Officers and Employees Expense (4142)'; 'Furniture  Fixtures; Equipment and Automobile Expense (4221)'; 'Professional Services (4321)'; 'Service Fees on Loans  Purchased (4154)'; 'Amortization of Goodwill (4322)'; 'Amortized Deferred Losses on Futures/Options Hedging  Assets (4323)'; 'Amortized Deferred Losses on Future/Options Hedging Liabilities (4324)' and 'Other Operating Expense (4325)'.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 1/31/89; includes 'Commission Paid for Savings Accounts (4144)'.

item_name: AMORTIZATION OF GOODWILL
mdrm_description: Includes amortization of goodwill and other intangible assets reported in 'Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets (0507)' in accordance with FAS No. 72; 'Accounting for Certain Acquisitions of Banking or Thrift Institutions.'   Excludes amortization of loan servicing rights; deducted from item 0487.   NOTE:   Beginning 9/30/01; definition revised; now includes amortization of:   1. Goodwill; an unidentifiable intangible asset; recorded pursuant to APB No. 141.  2. The unidentifiable intangible asset recorded pursuant to SFAS No. 72.  3. Core deposit premium; an identifiable intangible asset.  4. Other identifiable intangible assets.   Also; includes impairment write-downs on goodwill and other intangible assets.   Do not include amortization of Servicing Assets; report this in item 0487.   U

item_name: NONOPERATING EXPENSES; PROVISION FOR LOSSES AND LOSSES ON SALE OF FORECLOSED REAL ESTATE (REO)
mdrm_description: Includes losses or provisions for losses from the sale of foreclosed real estate reported in items 0457; 0458; and 0459.    When computing the gain or loss on the sale of foreclosed real estate; adjust the carrying value for all yield  adjustments; including deferred gains and losses from hedging activities; accrued interest receivable; and valuation allowances. Gains are reported in item 3842.

item_name: NONOPERATING EXPENSE; PROVISION FOR LOSSES AND LOSSES ON SALE OF OTHER REAL ESTATE HELD
mdrm_description: Includes losses or provisions for losses with respect to real estate held for investment reported in items 0462; 0465; and 1581.    When computing the gain or loss on the sale of real estate held for investment; adjust the carrying value for all  yield adjustments; including deferred gains and losses from hedging activities; accrued interest receivable; and valuation allowances. Gains are reported in item 3844.

item_name: NET INCOME (LOSS)
mdrm_description: Includes the net income (loss) reported in item 4340 (Net Income (Loss)).  For most series (other than SVGL) this is a year-to-date value.     For the FR Y-11AS (BHAS) report; includes the sum of 'Net Income (3631)' and 'Extraordinary Items; Net of Income Taxes(4320)'.     For the 'BHCC' and 'BHCS' series; includes the sum of items 3631; 4320; and 3147 minus item 4302.     For the FR 2314a (SUBI) report; includes the sum of 'Income (Loss) Before Extraordinary Items (4300)' and 'Extraordinary Items; Net of Tax Effect (4320)'.     For the FFIEC 001 (TRST) report; includes item 4000 minus items 4130; A486; A487 and A488.     COMPARABILITY:     Beginning 3/31/04; reported on Schedule HC for the SVGL report. Report net income for the quarter.    Beginning 3/31/03; reported on Notes to the Incom

item_name: NONOPERATING EXPENSE; PROVISION FOR LOSSES AND LOSSES ON SALE OF LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes losses resulting from the sale of any asset of the type reportable in items (1518); (1519); (1470); (1447);  (1534); (1543); (1454); (1544) also (1568); (1569); (1458); (2050); (1459); (1990); (1466); (2008); (2035); (1571); and  (1572) or the sale of participating interests in such assets; or the establishment of; or an increase in the related  valuation allowances or reserves. Also includes losses on the origination of below market rate mortgages; and losses from discounting the prepayment of low interest rate mortgages.

item_name: AMORTIZED DEFERRED LOSSES ON LOANS SOLD
mdrm_description: Includes losses considered incurred during the period; in accordance with Regulation 563c.14; from sale of loans.

item_name: AMORTIZED DEFERRED LOSSES ON OTHER ASSETS SOLD
mdrm_description: Includes all losses not reported in 'Amortized Deferred Losses on: Loans Sold (4351)' considered incurred during the period; in accordance with Regulation 563.14; from the sale or disposition of other assets.

item_name: OTHER NONOPERATING EXPENSES
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount paid during the period for expenses of an unusual or nonrecurring nature that were not  reported in items (4327); (4328); (4329); (4181); (4348); (4349); (4351); and (4378) of this section. Includes premiums  paid in connection with the purchase of mortgage loans or contracts if the entire amount was charged-off at the time it was  incurred or paid and goodwill or intangible assets fully written off during the period. Also includes the amount of a net  debit made in order to convert to the accrual basis of accounting. If such initial adjustment is a credit; the credit should be reported in 'Other Nonoperating Income (4304)'.

item_name: TOTAL NONOPERATING EXPENSE
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Nonoperating Expense Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Foreclosed Real Estate  (REO) (4327)'; 'Nonoperating Expense; Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Other Repossessed Property  (4328)'; 'Nonoperating Expense; Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Other Real Estate Held (4329)';  'Provision for Losses and Losses on Sale of Investment Securities (4181)'; 'Nonoperating Expense; Provisions for  Losses and Losses on Sale of Loans (4348)'; 'Nonoperating Expense; Provisions for Losses and Losses on Sale of Other  Assets (4349)'; 'Amortized Deferred Losses on Loans Sold (4351)'; 'Amortized Deferred Losses on Other Assets Sold (4378)' and 'Other Nonoperating Expense (4379)'.

item_name: INTEREST INCOME ON DEPOSITS AND SECURITIES (INCLUDING MORTGAGE-BACKED SECURITIES)
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Interest on Mortgage-Backed Pass-Through Securities (4204)' and 'Interest and Dividends on Investments and Deposits (4037)'.

item_name: INTEREST AND DISCOUNTS ON MORTGAGE LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Interest on Mortgage Loans and Contracts (4203)' and 'Discounts on Mortgages Loans Purchased (4034)'.

item_name: INTEREST ON MORTGAGE ASSETS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Interest and Discounts on Mortgage Loans (4416)'; and 'Interest on Mortgage-Backed Pass-Through Securities (4204)'.

item_name: TOTAL INTEREST ON LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Interest and Discounts on Mortgage Loans (4416)'; 'Interest on Commercial Loans (Nonmortgage) (4244)'; and 'Consumer Loans (Opened- and Closed-End) (4281)'.

item_name: MISCELLANEOUS OPERATING INCOME
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Income from Financing Leases (4282)'; 'Amortized Deferred Gains on Futures/Options  Hedging Assets (4283)'; 'Amortized Deferred Gains on Futures/Options Hedging Liabilities (4284)' and 'Other Operating Income (4292)'.   COMPARABILITY:   Beginning 1/31/1997; for the CUCP report; includes the monthly total of all Other Operating Income/Loss accounts not listed in items 4523; 4010; 4184; and 4074.  A minus sign must be entered before entering the dollar amount if the account balance is a loss.   NOTE:   Reported on Schedule IS for the CUCP report.

item_name: INTEREST EXPENSE ON BORROWINGS
mdrm_description: Starting 19970331 formula = 'Interest on Borrowings' SVGL4192 - 'Capitalized Interest' SVGL4178.  COMPARABILITY:  Beginning March 31; 1990; 'Other Borrowed Money' (0482) replaced item 'Interest Expense on Other Borrowed Money' (4177).  Includes the sum of 'Interest Expense for Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance (4167)';  'Interest Expense on FHLBank Advances (4173)'; 'Interest on Subordinated Notes and Debentures (4200)'; 'Interest  Expense on Mortgage-Backed Bonds (4175)'; 'Interest Expense on Other Borrowed Money (4177)'; less 'Capitalized Interest (4178)'.  NOTE:  Derived Item.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS MATURING SIX MONTHS OR LESS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Mortgage Loans and Contracts; First Mortgage Loans; Balloon and Adjustable Rate (6335)' and 'Mortgage Loans and Contracts; First Mortgage Loans; Fixed Rate; 1-4 Dwelling Unit (6343)'.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS MATURING MORE THAN SIX MONTHS THRU ONE YEAR
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of 'Mortgage Loans and Contracts; First Mortgage Loans; Balloon and Adjustable Rate; More  Than Six Months Thru One Year (6336)' and 'Mortgage Loans and Contracts; First Mortgage Loans; Fixed Rate; 1-4 Dwelling Units (6344)'.

item_name: MORTGAGE BANKING OPERATIONS
mdrm_description: Includes the net gain or loss for the period resulting from marking to the 'lower of cost or market' mortgage loans  and mortgage-backed securities which the institution categorizes as being 'held for sale'; rather than for 'long-term  investment'. Also included is the net profit or loss from sale or disposition during the period mortgage loans and mortgage-backed securities that has been 'held for sale'.

item_name: ACCRETION OF DISCOUNTS AND FEES ON MORTGAGE LOANS AND CONTRACTS
mdrm_description: Includes accretion of discounts on loans and participations purchased; including those acquired through a  purchase merger that; in accordance with Reg.563.23 1(b); have been earned during the period and accretion of mortgage loan fees taken into income during the period in accordance with Reg.563.23 1(d).    Accretion of discounts and fee on mortgage-backed pass-through securities is reported in item 4204 (interest on  mortgage-backed pass-through securities); amortization of premiums is reported in item 4516 (amortization of  premiums on mortgage loans and contracts). Loan fees that are deferred but are taken into income currently are reported in item 'Mortgage Loan Fees (4038)'.

item_name: AMORTIZATION OF PREMIUMS ON MORTGAGE LOANS CONTRACTS
mdrm_description: Includes amortization of premiums paid for mortgage loans and participations purchased; including those acquired through a purchase merger.

item_name: AMORTIZATION OF DEFERRALS PURSUANT TO 563C.14
mdrm_description: Includes the amortization of losses; net of gains; on the sale of loans and other assets deferred under the election provided for in FHLBB Regulation 563c.14. The deferred loss being amortized is reported in item 3684.

item_name: REAL ESTATE: CONSTRUCTION
mdrm_description: Includes repossessed real estate that is in the process of construction. Excludes land being developed into building lots prior to the initiation of construction of improvements.

item_name: REAL ESTATE NONRESIDENTIAL (EXCEPT LAND)
mdrm_description: Includes repossessed nonresidential property; net of accumulated depreciation. Excludes land; which is reported in item 4860.

item_name: REAL ESTATE LAND
mdrm_description: Includes repossessed land.    Also; includes vacant land; developed building lots on which no building construction has begun; and land in the process of being subdivided and developed into lots.

item_name: MORTGAGE POOL SECURITIES CHARGE-OFFS
mdrm_description: Report the amount of loss that you charged off on items 3598; 3599; C513; C514; C541; and 0443.  Includes charge-off for the amount of loss that is charged off on items 3598 and 0443.  COMPARABILITY:  Prior to 3/31/04; included the amount of loss charged-off in items 3725 through 3875 (Mortgage Pool Securities).

item_name: MORTGAGE POOL SECURITIES RECOVERIES
mdrm_description: Report the amount of recoveries on all deposits and investment securities that are reported in items 3598; 3599; C513; C514; C541; and 0443.  Includes recoveries for the amount of loss that is charged off on items 3598 and 0443.  COMPARABILITY:  Prior to 3/31/04; included the amount of loss recovered in items 3725 through 3875 (Mortgage Pool Securities).

item_name: REAL ESTATE CONSTRUCTION
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of loss charged off in item 4856.

item_name: REAL ESTATE 1-4 DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of loss charged off in item 0457.

item_name: REAL ESTATE 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes the amount of loss charged off in item 0458.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS: CONSTRUCTION 30-89 DAYS

item_name: PORTION OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT (EXCLUDING FDIC LOSS-SHARING AGREEMENTS): CREDIT CARD LOANS TO INDIVIDUALS FOR HOUSEHOLD; FAMILY; AND OTHER PERSONAL EXPENDITURES
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of credit card loans to individuals for household; family; and other personal expenditures (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; item 6.a) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing agreements.

item_name: PORTION OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT (EXCLUDING FDIC LOSS-SHARING AGREEMENTS): OTHER CONSUMER LOANS (INCLUDES OTHER REVOLVING CREDIT PLANS; AUTOMOBILE LOANS; SINGLE PAYMENT; INSTALLMENT; AND ALL STUDENT LOANS)
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of other consumer loans (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; items 6.b; 6.c; and 6.d) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing agreements
