mdrm_description: Report the balance sheet amount of nontraditional 1-4 family residential mortgage loans (in domestic offices); which include all 1-4 family residential loan products that allow the borrower to defer repayment of principal or interest and includes all interest-only products; teaser rate mortgages; and negative amortizing mortgages; with the exception of home equity lines of credit and reverse mortgages. Nontraditional 1-4 family residential mortgage loans should include simultaneous second lien loans and closed-end home equity loans to the extent such loans meet any of the characteristics described above. item_name: TOTAL UNFUNDED COMMITMENTS TO FUND CONSTRUCTION; LAND DEVELOPMENT; AND OTHER LAND LOANS SECURED BY REAL ESTATE
mdrm_description: Report the unused portion of commitments (in domestic offices) to extend credit to fund construction; land development; and other land loans that; when funded; would be reportable as loans secured by real estate in Schedule RC-C; part I; item 1.a. The amount reported in this item should also have been included in the amounts reported in Schedule RC-L; items 1.c.(1)(a) and (b).

item_name: PORTION OF UNFUNDED COMMITMENTS TO FUND CONSTRUCTION; LAND DEVELOPMENT; AND OTHER LAND LOANS SECURED BY REAL ESTATE THAT ARE GUARNATEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT (INCLUDING THE FDIC)
mdrm_description: Report the amount of the unused portion of the construction; land development; and other land loan commitments reported in Schedule RC-O; Memorandum item 10.a; above that is recoverable from the U.S. government; its agencies; or government-sponsored agencies; under guarantee or insurance provisions; including guarantees by the FDIC such as under loss-sharing agreements.  Exclude amounts recoverable from state or local governments; state or local government agencies; foreign (non-U.S.) governments; and private agencies or organizations.

item_name: PORTIONS OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT: CONSTRUCTION; LAND DEVELOPMENT; AND OTHER LAND LOANS IN DOMESTIC OFFICES
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of construction; land development; and other land loans (in domestic offices) (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; item 1.a) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing agreements.  Exclude loans guaranteed or insured by state or local governments; state or local government agencies; foreign (non-U.S.) governments; and private agencies or organizations as well as loans collateralized by securities issued by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies.

item_name: PORTIONS OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT: LOANS SECURED BY MULTIFAMILY RESIDENTIAL AND NONFARM NONRESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES IN DOMESTIC OFFICES
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of loans secured by multifamily (5 or more) residential properties and loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties (in domestic offices) (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; items 1.d and 1.e.; respectively) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing agreements.  Exclude loans guaranteed or insured by state or local governments; state or local government agencies; foreign (non-U.S.) governments; and private agencies or organizations as well as loans collateralized by securities issued by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies.

item_name: PORTIONS OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT: CLOSED-END LOANS SECURED BY FIRST LIENS ON 1-4 FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES IN DOMESTIC OFFICES
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of closed-end loans secured by first liens on 1-4 family residential properties (in domestic offices) (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; item 1.c.(2)(a)) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing agreements.  Exclude loans guaranteed or insured by state or local governments; state or local government agencies; foreign (non-U.S.) governments; and private agencies or organizations as well as loans collateralized by securities issued by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies.

item_name: PORTIONS OF FUNDED LOANS GUARANTEED OR INSURED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT: CLOSED-END LOANS SECURED BY JUNIOR LIENS ON 1-4 FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES AND REVOLVING; OPEN-END LOANS SECURED BY 1-4 FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES AND EXTENDED UNDER LINES OF CREDIT (IN DOMESTIC OFFICES)
mdrm_description: Report the portion of the balance sheet amount of closed-end loans secured by junior liens on 1-4 family residential properties revolving; open-end loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties and extended under lines of credit (in domestic offices) (as defined for Schedule RC-C; part I; items 1.c.(2)(b) and 1.c.(1); respectively) that is guaranteed or insured by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored agencies; other than by the FDIC under loss-sharing.  Exclude loans guaranteed or insured by state or local governments; state or local government agencies; foreign (non-U.S.) governments; and private agencies or organizations as well as loans collateralized by securities issued by the U.S. government; including its agencies and its government-sponsored

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - U.S. GOVERNMENT; AGENCY; AND SPONSORED ENTERPRISE SECURITIES (LINE ITEM SC130)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of nonmortgage debt instruments issued by the U.S. Government; its agencies and sponsored enterprises held for trading. Exclude mortgage-backed securities.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - SECURITIES BACKED BY NONMORTGAGE LOANS (LINE ITEM SC182)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of the outstanding balance; as determined in accordance with GAAP; of all securities collateralized by nonmortgage loans such as credit card loans and auto loans held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - OTHER PASS-THROUGH MORTGAGE-BACKED SECURITIES (LINE ITEM SC215)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of mortgage pass-through securities that are not insured or guaranteed by an agency or sponsored enterprise of the U.S. held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - OTHER MORTGAGE BACKED SECURITIES (LINE ITEM SC222)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of all other mortgage-backed securities not reported on SVGL3598 through SVGLC514 held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - OTHER MORTGAGE BACKED SECURITIES (EXCLUDING BONDS) ISSUED OR GUARANTEED BY FNMA; FHLMC OR GNMA (LINE ITEM SC219)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of all residential mortgage pass-through securities issued or guaranteed by FNMA; FHLMC; or GNMA securitized mortgage derivatives that are collateralized by mortgage derivatives that FNMA; FHLMC; or GNMA held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - MORTGAGE BACKED SECURITIES OTHER THAN THE TWO PRECEDING CATEGORIES (LINE ITEMS SC210 AND SC217)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of mortgage pass-through securities insured or guaranteed by an agency or sponsored enterprise of the U.S. and securitized mortgage derivatives that FNMA; FHLMC or GNMA issues or guarantees held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - CONSTRUCTION LOANS (LINE ITEMS SC230; SC235; AND SC240)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of all construction; land development; and other land loans held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - LOANS SECURED BY LAND (LINE ITEM SC265)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of the outstanding balance of all loans secured by land held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - LOANS TO FINANCE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION AND OTHER LOANS TO FARMERS (LINE ITEM SC32)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of the outstanding balance of loans to finance agricultural production and Other Loans to Farmers held for trading.

item_name: TRADING ASSETS - OTHER CONSUMER LOANS (LINE ITEMS SC310; SC316; SC320; SC323; SC326 AND SC330)
mdrm_description: Report the total fair value of all extensions of credit to individuals for household; family; and other personal expenditures arising from prearranged overdraft plans and other revolving credit plans not accessed by credit cards held for trading.

item_name: REAL ESTATE LOANS SECURED BY FARMLAND (NOT HELD FOR TRADING) INCLUDED IN LOANS SECURED BY 'NONRESIDENTIAL PROPERTY' (LINE ITEM SC260)
mdrm_description: Report the total unpaid principal balance outstanding for all loans secured by farmland (not held for trading) reported in item SC260.

item_name: LOANS TO FINANCE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION AND OTHER LOANS TO FARMERS (NOT HELD FOR TRADING) INCLUDED IN 'SECURED' AND 'UNSECURED' COMMERCIAL LOANS (LINE ITEMS SC300 AND SC303)
mdrm_description: Report the total unpaid principal balance outstanding for all loans to finance agricultural production and other loans to farmers (not held for trading) included in secured and unsecured commercial loans reported in items SC300 and SC303.

item_name: ADVANCES FROM FEDERAL HOME LOAN BANK WITH A REMAINING MATURITY OF ONE YEAR OR LESS (INCLUDED IN LINE ITEM SC720)
mdrm_description: Report the total advances from Federal Home Loan Bank with a remaining maturity of one year or less included in items SC720.

item_name: MORTGAGE COLLATERALIZED SECURITIES ISSUED: CMOS (INCLUDING REMICS) WITH A REMAINING MATURITY OF ONE YEAR OR LESS (INCLUDED IN LINE SC740)
mdrm_description: Report the total Mortgage Collateralized Securities Issued: CMOs (including REMICs) with a Remaining Maturity of One Year or Less included in line item SC740.

item_name: ALL OTHER SALES
mdrm_description: Includes all other loans sold except those reported in items 0546 and 0547.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS DISBURSED: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes the gross principal of mortgage loans originated during the month; reported in item 0131.   Excludes construction loans secured by condominium projects; reported in item 0919.   NOTE:   This item is reported as confidential.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 3/31/1998; item name was 'Construction Loans For: 1-4 Dwelling Units'.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS DISBURSED: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes the gross principal of mortgage loans originated during the month; reported in item 0109. Also includes construction loans secured by condominium projects.   NOTE:   This item is reported as confidential.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 3/31/1998; item name was 'Construction Loans For: 5 Or More Dwelling Units'.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS DISBURDED: NONRESIDENTIAL
mdrm_description: Includes the gross principal of mortgage loans originated during the month reported in item 0133.    Includes both interim construction loans and combination construction permanent loans. Loans that provide  funds for both land acquisition and construction should be classified as construction loans; but if they provide funds for acquisition of land only; they are reported in 'Permanent Loans on: Land (0930)'.   NOTE:   This item is reported as confidential.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 3/31/1998; item name was 'Construction Loans For: Nonresidential'.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS DISBURSED: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS - LAND
mdrm_description: Includes the gross principal of mortgage loans originated during the month reported in item 1534. Also includes  developed building lots; land in the acquisition or development state (e.g.; loans for making improvements required for conversion to developed building lots); and unimproved land.    Excludes land used for farming; reported in item 0166; and combination land/construction loans; reported in items 0918; 0919; and 0926.   NOTE:   This item is reported as confidential.   COMPARABILITY:   Prior to 3/31/1998; item name was 'Permanent Loans On: Land'.

item_name: LOANS AND PARTICIPATIONS PURCHASED
mdrm_description: Includes the principal balance of all mortgage loans and participations in such loans purchased from others  during the reporting quarter. Includes mortgage loans and participations of the type reportable in items (1518); (1519); (1470); (1534); (1447); (1534); and (1543) only.

item_name: CASH REPAYMENT OF PRINCIPAL
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount of cash received during the reporting quarter repayment of the principal on all mortgage  loans and contracts of the type reportable in items (0131); (0109); (0133); (2687); (2689); (0136); and (1534). Includes  full and partial prepayments as well as scheduled amortization repayments. Does not include loan foreclosures; any non- cash transactions that reduce loan balances; or interest charges. Such transactions are reported in item 0179.  NOTE:  This item is reported as confidential.

item_name: NONMORTGAGE LOANS CLOSED OR PURCHASED: COMMERCIAL
mdrm_description: Includes all commercial nonmortgage loans closed or purchased during the quarter. Includes loans and leases reportable in items (1568); (1569); and (1572).   NOTE:   Beginning 9/30/01; definition revised and now includes disbusements of loans and financing leases that you originated or purchased during the quarter of the types reported in items (1568); (1569); and (1572).   This item is reported as confidential.   For SVGL report; reported in Schedule SC - Consolidated Cash Flow Information.

item_name: NONMORTGAGE LOANS CLOSED OR PURCHASED: CONSUMER
mdrm_description: Includes all consumer loans made or purchased during the quarter. Includes loans and leases reportable in items (1458); (2050); (1459); (1990); (2035); (0455); (2705); and (2707).   NOTE:   Beginning 9/30/01; definition revised and includes disbursements of loans and financing leases that you originated or purchased during the quarter of the types reported in items (1458); (2050); (1459); (1990); (2035); (0455); (2705); and (2707).   This item is reported as confidential.   For the SVGL report; reported in Schedule RC - Consolidated Cash Flow Information.

item_name: COMMITMENTS OUTSTANDING: TO ORIGINATE LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount of outstanding commitments at the end of the reporting period to originate (i.e.; closed  in the name of the reporting institution) loans of the types reportable in items (1518); (1519); (1470); (1447); (1534);  (1543); (1454); and (1544) and (1568); (1569); (1458); (2050); (1459); (1990); (1466); (2008); (2035); (1571); and (1572).

item_name: COMMITMENTS OUTSTANDING: TO PURCHASE LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount of outstanding commitments at the end of the reporting period to purchase either a whole mortgage and nonmortgage loans or a participating interests therein.

item_name: COMMITMENTS OUTSTANDING: TO SELL LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes outstanding commimitments to sell whole mortgage and nonmortgage loans or participating interests therein.   NOTE:   Definition revised 12/31/1999.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE LOANS ON: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount of new commitments made to builders; owners; or purchasers of real estate during the  reporting month to originate (i.e.; close in the name of the reporting institution) mortgage loans; regardless of whether they have been honored or are still outstanding and are classified 5 or more dwelling units.  NOTE:  This item is reported as confidential.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE LOANS ON: OTHER REAL ESTATE
mdrm_description: Includes commitments for loans on other improved property; land and farms.  NOTE:  This item is reported as confidential.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE LOANS ON: TO PURCHASE LOANS FROM OTHER ENTITIES
mdrm_description: Includes the total amount of new commitments made during the reporting month to purchase either a whole  mortgage loan or a participating interest therein of the type included in items 1073 thru 1080; regardless of whether they have been honored or are still outstanding.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE MORTGAGE LOANS ON: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Report the outstanding commitments to originate mortgage loans secured by 1-4 dwelling units. Include the full amount committed for revolving lines of credit not yet closed that will be secured by 1-4 dwelling units. Once the revolving line of credit has closed; report the unused line on item no. C518.  COMPARABILITY:  Prior to 6/30/04; included outstanding commitments; and mortgage loans in process for 1-4 dwelling units. Also includes any  liability entered to offset a wrap around loan. Does not include as a commitment unused lines of credit entered for consumer purposes.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE MORTGAGE LOANS ON: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Report outstanding commitments to originate mortgage loans secured by multifamily (5 or more) dwelling units. Include unused lines of credit committed for revolving lines of credit secured by permanent mortgages on multifamily (5 or more) dwelling units.  COMPARABILITY:  Prior to 6/30/04; included outstanding commitments; and mortgage loans in process for 5 or more dwelling units. Also includes  any liability entered to offset a wrap around loan. Does not include as a commitment unused lines of credit entered for consumer purposes.

item_name: TO ORIGINATE MORTGAGE LOANS ON: OTHER REAL ESTATE
mdrm_description: Report outstanding commitments to originate mortgage loans on nonresidential property and land. Include unused lines of credit committed for revolving lines of credit secured by permanent mortgages on nonresidential property.  COMPARABILITY:  Prior to 6/30/04; included commitments for loans on other improved property; land and farms.

item_name: TO PURCHASE/ORIGINATE NONMORTGAGE LOANS AND TO PURCHASE SECURITIES
mdrm_description: Includes total amount of commitments to purchase/originate nonmortgage loans in items 1082 thru 1084 and/or  purchase securities in item 1085 that are outstanding at month end regardless of the month in which the commitment was made.

item_name: OTHER BORROWED MONEY
mdrm_description: Includes all borrowings from entities other than FHL Banks. These include: (1) commercial bank loans; (2)  reverse and retail repurchase agreements; (3) overdrafts in demand deposits; (4) commercial paper issued; (5) subordinated debentures not qualifying for net worth; and (6) mortgage-backed bonds issued.

item_name: LOANS 60 OR MORE DAYS DELINQUENT; FORECLOSED REAL ESTATE AND REAL ESTATE IN JUDGMENT (NET) AND OTHER REPOSSESSED ASSETS (NET)
mdrm_description: Includes net of depreciation allowances; balances in: (1) real estate (REO) to which a marketable title has been  acquired by foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof; (2) real estate and other repossessed property (including mobile homes;  automobiles and other chattel) acquired in exchange for a schedule item as defined in Regulation 561.15; (3) real estate in  judgment to which a marketable title has not yet been acquired; and (4) repossessed property classified as scheduled  items. Also; the principal balance of all loans delinquent 60 or more days as of month end; including premiums; accrued  interest and amounts advanced for payment of borrowers' taxes and insurance not maintained in separate accounts: Contra assets applicable to such loans are not deducted.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS CLOSED: CONSTRUCTION LOANS
mdrm_description: Includes the principal amount of all secured loans and contracts made during the month to finance construction.  Includes increases to existing construction loans. The amount reported should be the gross contract amount; Loans in  process or other contra assets are not deducted. Includes both interim construction loans and combination construction  permanent loans. Loans that provide funds for both land acquisition and construction should be classified as construction loans; but if they provide funds for acquisition of land only; they are reported in item 0930.

item_name: MORTGAGE LOANS CLOSED: ALL OTHER
mdrm_description: Includes the principal amount of mortgage loans and contracts closed during the month that cannot be reported in  items 1051 and 0930. Includes previously reported combination construction permanent loans that became permanent during the month and loans on land used for farming.

item_name: GROSS OPERATING INCOME FROM THIS MONTH
mdrm_description: Includes total ordinary or recurring operating income earned during the month. Also included are the following  income items: (1) interest earned on mortgage loans and contracts; mortgage-backed securities; nonmortgage loans; and  investments and deposits; (2) discounts on mortgage loans participations; (3) fee income from mortgage loans; loan  servicing and transaction accounts; (4) income on leveraged financing leases; (5) amortization of deferred gains on  futures/options hedging transactions; (6) net income (loss) from office building operations; real estate held for investment; REO operations; service corporations/subsidiaries; leasing and (7) miscellaneous other operating income.

item_name: NET OPERATING INCOME FOR THIS MONTH
mdrm_description: Includes gross operating income; item 1053; less operating expenses and net interest charges. Operating expenses includes:    (1)   Directors fees paid during the month to directors; advisory board members; and members of       committees for attendance at board and committee meetings;    (2)   Officers and employees compensation including all salaries; wages; bonuses; or other compensation as        well as the institution's share of payroll taxes; premiums for related insurance; lunchroom expenses;       tuition fees; uniforms; and any other fringe benefits;   (3)   Legal fees;   (4)   All travel and other expenses paid to or for directors; officers; and employees;    (5)   All expenses related to an institution's occupancy of office quarters; furniture; fixtures; equipment; and       au

item_name: INTEREST CHARGES FOR THIS MONTH
mdrm_description: Includes the total interest charges during the month on deposits (net of early withdrawal penalties) and  borrowings (FHLBANK advances; commercial bank loans; reverse and retail repurchase agreements; commercial  paper; subordinated debentures; mortgage-backed bonds and other borrowed money) plus net amortized deferred gains  (losses) on futures/options hedging liabilities conducted in accordance with Regulations 563.17 4(g) and 563.17 5(g). Capitalized interest are not deducted.    Does not include interest charges for advance payment by borrowers for taxes and insurance. Interest charges as defined on this line differs from the amount computed in item 1054 (net operating income).

item_name: WERE BROKERS USED TO ACQUIRE LOANS?
mdrm_description: Respond with y (yes) only if the institution's use of a broker resulted in any loan acquisition (purchase or closing) this month.

item_name: WERE ANY LOANS MADE TO OR INVESTMENTS MADE IN ANY HOLDING COMPANY;  SUBSIDIARY; JOINT VENTURE OR OTHER AFFILIATE OF THE INSTITUTION?
mdrm_description: Respond with y  (yes) if a loan was originated during the month to such an affiliate or if any existing loan to such  an affiliate was rewritten during the month. Respond with n (no) if only a loan commitment; but no loan origination; was made during the month.

item_name: WAS THE INSTITUTION THE 'LEAD' LENDER IN ANY TRANSACTION CONSUMMATED THIS MONTH?
mdrm_description: Respond with y (yes) only if a loan origination or commitment was made during the month. Does not respond y for payoffs or foreclosures.

item_name: WAS (A) ANY SINGLE LOAN OR COMMITMENT MADE OR (B) ANY TOTAL OF LOANS OR COMMITMENTS MADE TO ONE BORROWER THAT EXCEED EITHER $1 MILLION OR TWO PERCENT OF THE INSTITUTION'S ASSETS AT THE END OF THE PRECEDING MONTH?
mdrm_description: Respond with y (yes) if any loan or loan commitment made during the month caused the total of loans and  commitments to one borrower to exceed during this month; either $1 million or 2 percent of the institution's  assets at the end of the preceding month.

item_name: CONSTRUCTION LOANS FOR: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes federally insured or guaranteed as well as conventional loans and contracts secured by real estate regardless of method acquired (directly; purchase or participating interest); to finance the erection of 1-4 dwelling units.

item_name: CONSTRUCTION LOANS FOR: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes federally insured or guaranteed as well as conventional loans and contracts secured by real estate  regardless of method acquired (directly; purchase or participating interest); to finance the erection of 5 or more dwelling units.

item_name: CONSTRUCTION LOANS FOR: OTHER PROPERTY
mdrm_description: Includes federally insured or guaranteed as well as conventional loans and contracts secured by real estate  regardless of method acquired (directly; purchase or participating interest); to finance structures whether existing of  under construction. These structures include mobile home parks; nursing homes; churches; stores; and other commercial property; as well as individually owned mobile home lots.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS ON: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes loans and contracts to finance the purchase of 1-4 dwelling units; the purchase of farm land to be used for farming; and the acquisition or development of vacant land or the acquisition of developed building lots.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS ON: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS
mdrm_description: Includes loans and contracts to finance the purchase of 5 or more dwelling units; the purchase of farm land to be used for farming; and the acquisition or development of vacant land or the acquisition of developed building lots.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS ON: OTHER IMPROVED PROPERTY (EXCLUDING LAND AND FARM)
mdrm_description: Includes loans and contracts to finance to purchase of structures whether existing or under construction;  including mobile home parks; nursing homes; churches; stores; and other commercial property; as well as individually owned mobile lots. Excludes land and farm.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS ON: LAND EXCEPT FARM
mdrm_description: Includes loans and contracts to finance the purchase of vacant land or developed building lots that are/will be prepared to initiate the actual erection of structures thereon.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS ON: FARM PROPERTY
mdrm_description: Includes loans and contracts to finance the purchase of properties used for farming regardless of the presence or absence of a dwelling unit on the property.

item_name: MORTGAGE-BACKED PASS-THROUGH SECURITIES(NET OF CONTRA ASSETS)
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of items 1454 and 1544 (Mortgage-backed Pass-through Securities) of the quarterly report;  plus the applicable portions of items 1455 (Accrued Interest Receivable) and 1456 (Advances For Borrowers' Taxes and Insurance); minus the applicable portions of items 3067 thru 1566 (Contra Assets To Mortgage Loans).

item_name: NONMORTGAGE LOANS (NET OF CONTRA ASSETS; BUT INCLUDING FINANCING LEASES) - LOANS ON DEPOSITS
mdrm_description: Includes the amount reported on loans on deposit (1458) of the quarterly report plus the applicable portion of  accrued interest receivable reported on item 1481 of the quarterly report minus the applicable portion of contra assets to nonmortgage loans reported on items 3068 thru 1574 of the quarterly report.

item_name: OTHER CONSUMER LOANS (INCLUDING FINANCING LEASES)
mdrm_description: Includes the amount reported in items 2050 thru 1571 (home improvement loans; education loans; consumer auto  loans; other closed-end consumer loans; credit cards and other open-end credit extended to consumers; mobile home  loans - retail and consumer financing leases) of the quarterly report plus the applicable portion of accrued interest  receivable reported in item 1481 of the quarterly report minus the applicable portion of contra assets to nonmortgage loans reported in items 3068 thru 1574 of the quarterly report.

item_name: COMMERCIAL LOANS (INCLUDING FINANCING LEASES)
mdrm_description: Includes the amount reported in items 1568; 1569 and 1572 (secured and unsecured commercial loans and  nonconsumer financing leases) of the quarterly report plus the applicable portion of accrued interest receivable reported  in item 1481 of the quarterly report minus the applicable portion of contra assets to nonmortgage loans reported in items 3068 thru 1574 of the quarterly report.

item_name: OTHER ASSETS
mdrm_description: Includes the sum of items 1577 and 1578 (repossessed assets); items 1580 and 1581 (real estate held for  development/investment/resale); items 0630 thru 0633 (fixed assets) and items 0634 thru 0642 (other assets) of the  quarterly report minus items 1492; 1498; 0862 and 0873 (valuation allowances for repossessed assets; real estate held for development/investment/resale; fixed assets and other assets).

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS CLOSED ON: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS: NEWLY BUILT
mdrm_description: Includes all mortgage loans closed during the month for 1-4 dwelling units which were newly built plus any amount allocated from item 0931 (permanent loans on all other) of the quarterly report.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS CLOSED ON: 1-4 DWELLING UNITS: PREVIOUSLY OCCUPIED
mdrm_description: Includes all mortgage loans closed during the month for 1-4 dwelling units which were previously occupied plus any amount allocated from item 0931 (permanent loans on all other) of the quarterly report.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS CLOSED ON: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS: NEWLY BUILT
mdrm_description: Includes all mortgage loans closed during the month for 5 or more dwelling units which were newly built plus any amount allocated from item 0931 (permanent loans on all other) of the quarterly report.

item_name: PERMANENT LOANS CLOSED ON: 5 OR MORE DWELLING UNITS: PREVIOUSLY OCCUPIED

item_name: TOTAL SECURITIES - BOOK VALUE (INCLUDING TRADING ACCOUNTS)
mdrm_description: The book value of all securities owned by the reporting bank including securities pledged; loaned; or sold under  repurchase or similar agreements. Also includes trading account securities and federal financing bank issues. Purchases  of sales of securities under repurchase or similar agreements do not affect this item. Does not include holdings of participations in pools of loans. Reserves for estimated losses or depreciation in securities are not deducted. item_name: ALLOWANCE FOR LOAN AND LEASE LOSSES AND ALLOCATED TRANSFER RISK RESERVE
mdrm_description: For banks with IBFs; foreign branches or subsidiaries; or Edge or Agreement subsidiaries; the allowance for  possible loan and lease losses covers the allowance for possible loan and lease losses at both foreign and domestic offices  of the bank except to the extent that banks opt to show allowance for possible loan and lease losses on the books of foreign  offices or Edge or Agreement subsidiaries. Likewise; the amount included in this item for allocated transfer risk reserve  excludes such amounts shown on the books of foreign offices or Edge or Agreement subsidiaries. The amount reported in  this item equals the sum of items 3123 and 3128 on schedule RC (Balance Sheet) of the Report of Condition; net of any amounts in these categories booked at foreign offices.
